stem_book: A small block slides with velocity 0.5√(gr) on the horizontal frictionless surface as shown in the figure. The block leaves the surface at point C. Calculate angle θ in the figure. (Figure: horizontal surface AB continues into a convex quarter-circle of radius r, centre O vertically below B; θ is the angle of OC from the vertical OB.)
work: g cosθ = v²/r, v² = 0.25gr + 2gr(1 − cosθ) ⇒ 3cosθ = 2.25 ⇒ cosθ = 3/4
